en: Vintage black‑and‑white winter view over a snow‑covered European city nestled in a valley, with hills in the background. In the foreground on the right stands a small chapel or wayside shrine on a slope, beside a winding path with railings and trees dusted with snow. The rooftops of the town and industrial chimneys are visible below. A printed caption in German runs along the bottom border of the image.
